cover.brief: Modern university building with a digital interface overlay floating beside it, a laptop showing a clean dashboard, and a smartphone with a QR code badge. Flat line-art, thin strokes, positioned on the left/right edge so the center stays ivory.

campus.brief: A university campus gate and a clock icon with dotted schedule lines floating around it; subtle, at the edge.

problem.brief: Scattered paper documents, disconnected app icons and a broken chain around a stressed student silhouette; flat line-art, soft, at the edges.

solution.brief: One unified platform tile assembling scattered pieces, a smartphone with a QR badge and an arrow unifying them into a single gear; line-art.

product.brief: Cloud icon (hosting), a shield (privacy), a gear (maintenance) and a headset (support) arranged in a neat row at the bottom edge, thin line-art.

value.brief: Rising trend arrow crossing a large target circle with small star marks, flat line-art at the corner.

vision.brief: A lighthouse beam in the distance over curved horizon lines, and a small target with a checkmark floating beside it; line-art.

market.brief: A circular diagram: a university building at the center and three small figures (student, professor, staff) around it connected by thin arcs; line-art.

competition.brief: Four clean horizontal/vertical bar columns of varying heights, the tallest in teal and the rest in navy/light gray, as a minimal flat bar chart with no labels.

advantage.brief: A shield with a checkmark at its center, a lock, and a badge ribbon; flat line-art at the edge.

pricing.brief: A price tag with a small funnel beside it and three coin circles floating above, flat line-art at the corner.

journey.brief: A horizontal pathway of seven equal empty circles connected by a thin line winding gently, flat minimal line-art.

ops.brief: A handshake, a gear and two small work-process squares connected by thin lines; line-art at the edge.

finance.brief: Coins stacked as a bar chart with an ascending arrow, flat line-art at the corner.

closing.brief: A small university building and a rising sun/light beam at the far edge, mostly empty ivory space, flat line-art.
